verdict.rationale: A community user names Datadog's main advantage as correlating APM traces, custom metrics and logs through shared tagging, with data densely linked across the platform. That account is backed by first-party APM/tracing and Log Management docs, though only their titles are in the pack. One user calls the correlation weaker than Honeycomb's or Dynatrace's, but that is a comparative opinion, not a concrete failure, so it lowers confidence rather than creating a dispute. Missing for 10: first-party doc content describing the span-to-logs and span-to-metrics pivot workflow, hands-on corroboration of debugging a single request end to end.
